versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions for more precise onboarding.
- Now includes links to both the real-time dashboard ([ppspy.com](https://www.ppspy.com/)) and the direct API management site ([api.ppspy.com](https://api.ppspy.com/)).
- Clarifies where to obtain your API key and manage billing/recharge.
- No changes to available features or tools.

best-shopify-stores v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "Best Shopify Stores" skill.
- Discover and filter Shopify stores using PPSPY by traffic, revenue, language, region, theme, and store structure.
- Includes 6 tools for advanced Shopify store and theme search and discovery.
- Requires a PPSPY API key for access.
